<Rep. Lloyd Doggett>: Congress of the United States,
House of Representatives,
Washington, DC, March 26, 2026. Hon. Jason Smith, Chairman, Committee on Ways and Means, House of Representatives, Washington, DC.
Dear Chairman Smith: For the Committee bill report for H.R. 7959, the IRS Whistleblower Program Improvement Act, please enter as additional views two reports that I referenced in my comments during the debate:
• Treasury Inspector General For Tax
Administration, ``The IRS Has Yet to Develop a
Successful Strategy for Examining Large Partnership
Returns,'' March 18, 2026.
• Institute for Taxation and Economic Policy,
``IRS Enforcement Boost Was Supposed to Last 10 Years.
Congress Killed It in Under Three,'' September 16,
2025.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
Sincerely,
Lloyd Doggett.
